firms.name: Spice Prop

platformEvidence.sourceQuote: We would like to inform traders about upcoming changes to the tick size settings for several cryptocurrency symbols available on our MT5 servers.
platformEvidence.notes: Homepage news item; the footer says 'Download the MetaTrader trading platform or use the web terminal'. No other platform named on the pages checked.

firms.countriesRestrictedQuote: To avoid potential regulatory issues, even if no trading is occurring, we cannot register citizens from the following countries: USA North Korea Eritrea Iran Iraq Liberia Libya Somalia Sudan Syria Japan Canada Puerto Rico Indonesia
firms.countriesRestrictedNote: Site-wide footer (same list on https://spiceprop.com/, /qa and /ru, where it reads 'мы не можем регистрировать клиентов из следующих стран'). Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and Kazakhstan are not named. The list is not exhaustive for eligibility: Terms 2.2 also excludes 'restricted or sanctioned countries' and 9.4 persons on EU/UN/UK/OFAC lists (see russiaStatusNote).
firms.russiaStatusNote: Russia is not on the footer list, but the Terms (General Terms of Service, 'Effective Date: 16 October 2025', checked 2026-10-21) exclude sanctioned countries without naming them: 2.2 'Citizens, residents, or persons located in restricted or sanctioned countries are not eligible.' and 9.4 'Services are unavailable to residents of restricted/sanctioned regions; Persons on EU, UN, UK, or OFAC sanctions lists'. Governing law is Czech (11.3) and payments run through a Prague s.r.o. and a Hong Kong company. No primary source says Russia is accepted or excluded, so 'unclear', not 'available'. 2.2 tests citizenship, residence and location; 9.6 requires KYC and trading from IT infrastructure 'consistent with their actual geolocation' (VPN/VPS only if approved).
